z.enum([\"prepare\", \"check\"]).default(\"prepare\"),\n  })\n  .strict();\nconst limit = 256_000;\n\nexport default function* SubmissionGuide(value: unknown) {\n  const { repository, directory, mode } = input.parse(value);\n  const acquired = yield* Component.operations.tryContent();\n  if (acquired.failure !== undefined) {\n    throw acquired.failure;\n  }\n  const text = acquired.text;\n  const expected = describe(directory + \"/submission-guide.md\", text);\n  if (text.length > limit || expected.utf8Bytes > limit) {\n    throw new Error(\"The submission guide exceeds 256000 characters or UTF-8 bytes.\");\n  }\n  yield* clear(text);\n  const receipt = directory + \"/submission-guide.json\";\n  if (mode === \"prepare\") {\n    if (!(yield* unused(repository, expected.path)) || !(yield* unused(repository, receipt))) {\n      throw new Error(\"The submission guide is occupied or unavailable; preserve this attempt.\");\n    }\n    yield* write(repository, expected.path, text);\n    yield* write(repository, receipt, JSON.stringify(expected));\n  }\n  const recorded = descriptor.parse(JSON.parse(yield* read(repository, receipt, limit)));\n  const retained = yield* read(repository, expected.path, limit);\n  if (!same(expected, recorded) || !same(expected, describe(expected.path, retained))) {\n    throw new Error(\n      \"The frozen submission guide changed; preserve the raw reply. No successor is admitted.\",\n    );\n  }\n  return expected;\n}\n"}}}

substantive outcome, source or evidence.\",issues:[]}}} />\n</If>\n</If>\n<If condition={checked.ok && props.profile.kind === \"delivery-editorial\" && checked.value.outcome === \"pass\" && JSON.stringify(checked.value.metadata) !== JSON.stringify(applied)}>\n<Let as=\"checked\" value={{ok:false,rejection:{kind:\"response_validation\",code:\"applied-text\",message:\"The response does not name the exact already applied title/body.\",issues:[]}}} />\n</If>\n<Dir path={directory}><File path=\"disposition.json\"><Json value={{ordinal:round,accepted:checked.ok,rejection:checked.ok ? null : checked.rejection,raw:rawPath,deliveryIdentity:directory + \"/request.json\",originalInputsRepeated:false}} /></File></Dir>\n<If condition={!checked.ok}><Let as=\"diagnostics\" value={[...diagnostics,directory + \"/disposition.json\"]} /></If>\n</Loop>\n<If condition={!checked.ok}>\n<Let as=\"code\" value={props.maxResponseCorrections === 0 ? \"response_correction_disabled\" : round === props.maxResponseCorrections ? \"response_correction_exhausted\" : \"response_correction_unestablished\"} />\n<Dir path={props.attempt}><File path=\"response-disposition.json\"><Json value={{status:\"failed_without_result\",dispatchable:false,code,consumed:round,limit:props.maxResponseCorrections,diagnostics,lastRejection:checked.rejection,substantiveEstablished:frozen !== null}} /></File></Dir>\n<Fail message={code + \": \" + round + \" corrections consumed; no canonical result or successor. Inspect \" + props.attempt + \"/response-disposition.json\"} />\n</If>\n</If>\n<Phase.Accept assignment={props.assignment} role={props.role} profile={props.profile} text={raw} as=\"result\" />\n<Return value={{result,round,rawPath,diagnostics,normalizations:checked.normalizations ?? []}} />\n"}}}
